type Span struct{Start int; End int; Category string; Original string}

func Text(ctx context.Context, text string, options ...TextOptions) (TextResult, error)

func Value[T any](input T, options ...ValueOptions) (T, error)
type ValueOptions struct{Categories []string; Strategy Strategy; MaskText string; MaskChar rune; MaskLength int; JumbleSeed int64; JumbleMode JumbleMode; CustomPatterns []string}
